title: Volcanoes of Japan (guided)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Japan, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders to help you.

rounds.name: Mount Haruna
rounds.fact: Mount Haruna is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,449 m in the source data. The data places it in Japan.

rounds.name: Izu-Torishima
rounds.fact: Izu-Torishima is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1939. The data places it in Japan.
